translatorNotes: Register: informal tú, consistent with Phases 1–2.

'without the fluff' -> 'sin relleno'; 'playbooks' -> 'guías'; 'no shows' -> 'ausencias'; 'RFQ' kept; 'WISMO'/'where is my order' -> '¿dónde está mi pedido?'; 'where is my shipment' -> '¿dónde está mi envío?'; 'fair housing' -> 'vivienda justa'; 'break even' -> 'punto de equilibrio'; 'nurture sequences' -> 'secuencias de cultivo'.
Dates: 'August 2026' -> 'Agosto 2026', 'July 2026' -> 'Julio 2026'; 'X min read' -> 'X min de lectura'. Read-time numbers unchanged.

Stats inside excerpts kept exact ('12,000 agencies' -> '12.000 agencias', '65 percent' -> '65 por ciento', '62/86 percent', '40 to 60 percent', '38 percent', '70 percent', '60%'). Percent sign vs 'por ciento' matches source usage.
Product/brand names kept: Veyrais, n8n, Make, Zapier, LinkedIn, Meta, Shopify, ServiceTitan, Jobber, Housecall Pro, TMS, ERP, HIPAA, CRM, DM.
All 24 card links -> /es/blog/<slug> (English slugs unchanged); those 23 Spanish posts are being built in this Phase 3 pass, so they resolve once complete. lang-switch EN link -> /blog.
